tagline: Smart farming powered by artificial intelligence.
description: AgriBot is an Africa-first agricultural AI platform. 6 AI-powered products for crop disease detection, farm analytics, microfinance, market intelligence, weather forecasting, and supply chain tracking.
seoTitle: AgriBot — Agricultural AI Africa | Smart Farming | Crop Disease Detection
seoDescription: Africa-first agricultural AI platform. AgriScan, AgriInsight, AgriFinance, AgriMarket, AgriWeather, AgriTrack. Empowering African farmers with AI. Teaser: Madagascar first.

sections.title: Farming Powered by AI
sections.content: 6 AI products designed for African agriculture. Starting in Madagascar.

items.name: AgriScan
items.desc: Point your phone at a crop. Get instant disease diagnosis with treatment recommendations.

items.name: AgriInsight
items.desc: Farm analytics dashboard. Yield predictions, soil health monitoring, resource optimization.

items.name: AgriFinance
items.desc: Microloans powered by harvest data. Connect farmers with fair credit based on real yields.

items.name: AgriMarket
items.desc: Marketplace connecting farmers directly to buyers. Better prices, less waste.

items.name: AgriWeather
items.desc: Hyper-local weather forecasts tailored to your fields. Planting and harvesting recommendations.

items.name: AgriTrack
items.desc: Supply chain tracking from farm to table. Traceability, quality control, logistics.
